title: Who Is Westcol, the Influencer Hit by His Own Robot on a Livestream?
key_facts: Colombian streamer Luis Fernando Villa Alvarez, known as Westcol, 25, was hit by his own robot during a livestream.
He was livestreaming with Colombian singer Blessd as they prepared to dance with the robot.
With his back turned, he was struck hard on the back of the head by the robot.
Earlier, during control tests, the robot delivered a hard kick that broke a display case in his studio.
He says the robot must be programmed in advance for his part in Stream Fighters 5 on 14 Nov.
He says on social media that it stands 5 feet 7 inches tall and cost about $100,000.
quote_evidence: While his back was turned, Westcol was struck hard on the back of the head by the robot.
Earlier, during control tests, the singer of "Mirame" was unable to keep the robot from delivering a hard kick that broke a display case in Westcol's studio.
why_it_matters_hint: A robot meant for a stage show hit its owner during a rehearsal stream, showing how much programming and control a robot needs near people.
notes: Single outlet, no injury details and no robot maker named. The article's background on the streamer's past controversies is not relevant to the story and was left out.
